label: Add test for parentDocId fallback path in recall.spec.ts
summary: Added integration test for the session_id fallback path in parent-context expansion. The test creates a child node with session_id pointing to the parent's UID, verifies no DERIVED_FROM edge exists, runs memoryRecall with parent-context expansion, and asserts that expandedText includes parent content and expansionSources has both depth=0 (child) and depth=1 (parent).

changes.kind: added import declarations + DB helpers + parent-context expansion session_id fallback test

handoff_notes: The new test follows the same tmpDb()/cleanup() pattern as update.spec.ts
SOX_EMBED_BACKEND=hash is forced at module scope (same as update.spec.ts)
AfterAll calls _shutdownEmbedWorker() to clean up the embed worker thread
The test does NOT create any DERIVED_FROM edge — exercises the session_id fallback path at recall.ts:587-621
Relies on the temporal recall signal to surface the child node; child is most-recent-created in a 2-node DB
